turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. My son found out he got a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, Hale?
You didn't answer my question. Who decided?
Crazy weather today, eh? Did you see the Flames game?
We're not here about hockey, Hale. You have about eighteen minutes, and I'm still waiting to hear who entered that zero and why.
What do you do for fun?
I'm writing down that you asked me that. If you're not ready to talk about Owen, I'll take it up with the principal on my way out.
